code:
use default
use IO.Std.read_line

let tokens mut = 12

write_line("take 1, 2 or 3 tokens a turn; taking the last one wins")

while tokens > 0 do
    write_line("{tokens} left. How many do you take?")

    let line = read_line()

    if !line? then
        write_line("no more input")
        break
    fi

    write_line("> {line}")

    let taken mut = 0

    if !int.try_parse(line, taken ref) \/ taken < 1 \/ taken > 3 then
        write_line("take 1, 2 or 3")
        continue
    fi

    let reply = 4 - taken
    tokens = tokens - taken - reply

    write_line("you take {taken}, the computer takes {reply}")
od

if tokens == 0 then
    write_line("the computer took the last token and wins")
fi

use default
use IO.Std.read_line

let tokens mut = 12

write_line("take 1, 2 or 3 tokens a turn; taking the last one wins")

while tokens > 0 do
    write_line("{tokens} left. How many do you take?")

    let line = read_line()

    if !line? then
        write_line("no more input")
        break
    fi

    write_line("> {line}")

    let taken mut = 0

    if !int.try_parse(line, taken ref) \/ taken < 1 \/ taken > 3 then
        write_line("take 1, 2 or 3")
        continue
    fi

    let reply = 4 - taken
    tokens = tokens - taken - reply

    write_line("you take {taken}, the computer takes {reply}")
od

if tokens == 0 then
    write_line("the computer took the last token and wins")
fi
